races.paceDynamic: Hammer The Hammer will lead unchallenged early, setting a sustainable pace over this minimum trip. The real tactical battle develops behind him where 9 horses want prominent positions - Jakajaro, Bergerac, Sturlasson, Luna A Inbhir Nis, Heavenly Heather, Eternal Sunshine, Against The Wind, and the Easterby pair Copper Knight and I'm Next will create severe congestion through the first 2-3 furlongs. This congestion will compromise many prominent runners and create stopping problems 2f out when the real pace injection begins. The race strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and deliver late runs down the outside.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets bunched and hampers each other's acceleration from 2f out
scenarios.body: The likes of Redorange, Air Force One, Toca Madera and Corolla Point can sweep past the stalled prominent runners who've been caught in traffic. Ryan Moore on Redorange particularly benefits from this scenario given his ability to find racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Escapes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the higher-rated prominent horses like Jakajaro or Luna A Inbhir Nis secures an unimpeded passage
scenarios.body: They can capitalize on Hammer The Hammer's sustainable early pace and kick clear before the hold-up horses organize their challenges. Jamie Spencer's tactical nous on Jakajaro makes him the most likely to navigate the early congestion.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hammer The Hammer Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is slower than expected and no serious challenge materializes until too late
scenarios.body: His 215-day break becomes irrelevant over 5f and he can dictate terms throughout, with Jack Callan keeping enough in reserve for the final furlong. The Kevin Ryan pair would dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion is so severe that the entire field comes back to the leaders inside the final 2f
scenarios.body: This creates a blanket finish where any horse can win, favoring those with recent race fitness and strong finishing kicks. The O'Meara pair benefit from recent runs and good current form.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe traffic problems in the first 2-3 furlongs where 9 prominent runners including Jakajaro, Sturlasson, and Against The Wind will be fighting for similar positions
Monitor whether Hammer The Hammer can handle the 215-day absence over this minimum trip as the only confirmed pace-setter
Keep eye on Ryan Moore's positioning on Redorange given his 235-day break and whether the hold-up tactics can overcome ring-rustiness
Look for Air Force One and Toca Madera to be delivered late and wide to avoid the early traffic snarl-ups
Watch if any of the prominent runners like Jakajaro or Luna A Inbhir Nis can secure clean early positions to avoid the tactical chaos

races.paceDynamic: Point Lynas will take them along at a sustainable pace from the front, with Mirsky, Point Of Contact, Old Cock, Croupier and First Principle likely to track him in the first half of the field. With only one confirmed front-runner in a large field, Point Lynas won't face early pressure and can dictate terms through steady fractions. The lack of pace pressure will create a tactical affair where positions matter less than finishing kick, setting up perfectly for hold-up horses with proven turn of foot. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can quicken late over the prominent racers and the lone leader.

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Fallen Angel is the only confirmed front runner and will set a comfortable, sustainable pace without pressure through the early stages. Red Letter and Diamond Rain will likely track in second and third, with See The Fire and the hold-up types settling further back. This race will develop into a sprint finish from the 2f pole as the pace quickens significantly. The lack of pace pressure early followed by a strong gallop home clearly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late runs, particularly See The Fire who thrives when able to come from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady allowing closers to build momentum
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows See The Fire to settle perfectly and unleash her devastating finishing kick. Hold-up horses get ideal positioning as the race becomes a sprint finish from 2f out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Red Letter or Diamond Rain can secure ideal tracking positions behind Fallen Angel
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leaders and have enough tactical speed to hold off late challengers. Red Letter's recent form suggests she can capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Fallen Angel maintains her rhythm and quickens at the right moment
scenarios.body: Her class and tactical advantage of dictating terms allows her to repel all challengers despite the long absence. The reduced field size makes it harder for closers to get clear runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely slow creating a sprint from 3f out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where tactical position matters most and form lines become unreliable. Any horse getting a clear run could capitalize on the scramble.

races.paceDynamic: Item and Guildmaster will contest the early lead, with Item returning from a 226-day break potentially keen to use his natural pace. This dual pressure creates an honest gallop through the first mile, with prominent runners Action, Al Zanati, Christmas Day and Morshdi tracking in the second rank. The sustained pace will stretch the field entering the home straight, leaving the hold-up pair Wise Prince and King's Trail needing significant acceleration from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Item and Guildmaster engage early and set honest fractions without collapsing
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and allows the prominent trio of Action, Al Zanati and Christmas Day to strike from ideal positions. Their superior class ratings and tactical positioning prove decisive over the tiring leaders and struggling hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Excel
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Item and Guildmaster becomes overly strong and compromises the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The hot gallop sets up perfectly for Wise Prince and King's Trail to unleash finishing kicks from the rear. Both possess the class and acceleration to sweep past tiring rivals in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leaders Steal Home
scenarios.trigger: If Item settles better than expected from his long break and Guildmaster travels smoothly
scenarios.body: The early pace proves sustainable rather than suicidal, allowing one of the front two to kick clear in the straight. Item's previous class or Guildmaster's recent Newmarket third gives them enough left to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Morshdi Times Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the Haggas runner can secure the ideal trip tracking the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: His recent winning form and tactical speed allow him to emerge from the pack at the crucial moment. The son of Kingman has shown he can quicken off any pace and his 111 rating puts him right in the mix.

races.paceDynamic: Revival Power and Simplify will contest the early lead, both confirmed front runners with strong records when getting on the pace. Revival Power has three wins from the front while Simplify has two recent victories including last time out. Their clash should create a solid gallop over this minimum trip, though not suicidal given both horses' tactical awareness. The honest tempo will stretch the field and expose those needing cover, particularly with 11 runners creating traffic issues. This pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can sit just off the leaders and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Revival Power and Simplify go too hard in their early battle
scenarios.body: The sustained duel weakens both leaders in the final furlong, opening the door for horses tracking in behind. Hold-up horses like Manatee Mehmas and Dickensian benefit most from the strong pace and can unleash late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Revival Power or Simplify settles into an uncontested lead after early skirmishing
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run and holds off challengers, with their rival fading after the early efforts. Prominent racers who track the pace without getting involved early provide the main dangers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but both leaders show resilience in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Horses positioned prominently but not committed to the early pace can strike with perfectly timed runs. The solid gallop suits their tactical positioning while exposing those held up too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems develop in the closing stages with the large field bunching up
scenarios.body: A horse with clear sailing room or getting a perfect split can capitalize while better fancied rivals get stopped in their runs. The 5f straight becomes crucial for positioning.

watchPoints.text: Revival Power and Simplify could go too fast early if neither concedes the lead, weakening both for the finish

Manatee Mehmas produced a career-best last time here and looks the main beneficiary of a strong pace
Exclamation running again after just six days could find the quick turnaround taking its toll late on
The large 11-runner field increases the chances of traffic problems developing in the home straight

races.paceDynamic: Northern Brave, Hard To Believe, and Parisian Scholar will ensure a strong early gallop over this stamina-testing 1m4f trip. All three are confirmed front-runners who rarely settle, creating a genuine pace battle from the start. The sustained gallop will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish powerfully, as the early pace will compromise the leaders and set up a tactical advantage for those tracking from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and weaken markedly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the front-runners' stamina limitations, allowing hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks to sweep past tired leaders. Cotton Bud and Stoneacre Donny both have winning form at this distance and can capitalize on the expected pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate more sensible fractions despite the competition
scenarios.body: Hard To Believe or Northern Brave could find the tactical speed to control the tempo better than expected, holding enough in reserve to resist late challengers. Their class edge may prove decisive if they can avoid a pace war.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can sit just off the pace and avoid the early speed duel
scenarios.body: Horses like Pendella and Sudbury Hill can benefit from tracking the leaders closely without engaging in the early battle. They would have the perfect position to strike when the leaders begin to tire in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go suicidally fast and completely collapse in unison
scenarios.body: The entire front group could tie up dramatically, allowing a deep closer like Heroics or Arc Ole Ole to come from last to first. This would require an extreme pace scenario but is possible given the aggressive front-running styles involved.
